verses.english: Linked Discourses 21.12
1. Monks
Companions
At Sāvatthī.

verses.pali: Atha kho dve bhikkhū sahāyakā āyasmato mahākappinassa saddhivihārino yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṁsu.
verses.english: Then two mendicants who were companions, protégés of Venerable Mahākappina, went to see the Buddha.

verses.pali: Addasā kho bhagavā te bhikkhū dūratova āgacchante.
verses.english: The Buddha saw them coming off in the distance,
and addressed the mendicants:

verses.pali: “passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, ete bhikkhū sahāyake āgacchante kappinassa saddhivihārino”ti?
verses.english: “Mendicants, do you see those monks coming who are companions, protégés of Venerable Mahākappina?”
“Yes, sir.”
“Those mendicants are very mighty and powerful.

verses.pali: Na ca sā samāpatti sulabharūpā, yā tehi bhikkhūhi asamāpannapubbā.
verses.english: It’s not easy to find an attainment that they have not already attained.

verses.pali: Yassa catthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṁ brahmacariyapariyosānaṁ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantī”ti.
verses.english: And they’ve realized the supreme end of the spiritual path in this very life. They live having achieved with their own insight the goal for which gentlemen rightly go forth from the lay life to homelessness.”
That is what the Buddha said.

verses.pali: Idaṁ vatvāna sugato athāparaṁ etadavoca satthā:
verses.english: Then the Holy One, the Teacher, went on to say:
“These companion mendicants
have been together for a long time.
The true teaching has brought them together,
the teaching proclaimed by the Buddha.
They’ve been well trained by Kappina
in the teaching proclaimed by the Noble One.
They bear their final body,
having vanquished Māra with his legions.”
The Linked Discourses on monks are complete.
The Book of Causality is finished.
